caption: The drawing shows a single cylindrical metal object, likely a mug or cup, positioned in the center against a plain, light beige background. The mug is rendered in shades of brown, gray, and muted metallic colors, giving it a worn, slightly tarnished appearance. The object has a handle affixed to its side, and on the left, a spout-like attachment with a round, star-shaped end is visible. The rim of the cup is uneven, and the shadow at its base suggests it is positioned on a flat surface. There are no additional objects or background elements, and the image is marked with small text reading "S.D. Klein" near the bottom right of the drawing, indicating the artist’s name.
